title_en: Partnership Secures $2M Nyquist Colt at Keeneland
description: The partnership of St. Elias Stable, West Point Thoroughbreds, Lane's End Racing and Belladonna secures their most expensive purchase to date during the Keeneland September Yearling Sale by purchasing a Nyquist colt for $2 million Sept. 17.

title_en: Our Moneyman Brings Calhoun Back to Pennsylvania Derby
description: Our Moneyman arrived at Parx Racing early Sept. 17 and will make his first trip to the track Sept. 18. He'll look to not only win his first graded stakes, but a grade 1 after finishing second in the Matt Winn and Indiana Derby (both G3).

title_en: Sandman Will Start Stud Career in 2027 at Rockridge
description: Classic-placed Arkansas Derby (G1) winner Sandman (Tapit—Distorted Music by Distorted Humor) will stand the upcoming breeding season at Rockridge Stud near Hudson, N.Y., it was announced Sept. 17.

title_en: Always a Runner Seeks Winner's Circle in Cotillion
description: Kentucky Oaks (G1) victress Always a Runner looks to get back to her winning ways in the $1 million Cotillion Stakes (G1) Sept. 19 at Parx Racing.

title_en: Waller Holds Strong Hand in Underwood Stakes
description: Champion trainer Chris Waller will run three horses in the Sept. 19 Underwood Stakes (G1) at Caulfield Racecourse.

title_en: Speedway Stable Purchases $2M Not This Time Colt
description: A Not This Time colt out of 2012 Kentucky Oaks (G1) winner Believe You Can stars during the fourth day of the Keeneland September Yearling Sale, selling to Speedway Stable, via agent Marette Farrell, for $2 million.

title_en: Sepals Looks for Back-to-Back Sir Rupert Clarke Wins
description: Mornington-based trainer Cliff Brown will have a pair of runners in the Sept. 19 Sir Rupert Clarke Stakes (G1) at Caulfield Racecourse. Both Sepals and Von Hauke will tackle the 1,400-meter (about 7-furlong) sprint.

title_en: Carlisle Lands $1.6M Gun Runner Colt at Keeneland
description: Bloodstock agent Lauren Carlisle makes the purchase during the ongoing Keeneland September Yearling Sale, acquiring Hip 790, a Gun Runner colt, for $1.6 million during the first hour of the sale Sept. 17.

title_en: Summers Buys $2 Million Not This Time Colt for Gold
description: Trainer Chad Summers, as agent for Al Gold's Gold Square, purchases a $2 million Not This Time colt Sept. 17 during the fourth day of the Keeneland September Yearling Sale.

title_en: No Fee for Silks, Stable Name Registration at NY Tracks
description: The Jockey Club announces that a fee will no longer be required for silks or stable name registration at New York Racing Association racetracks or Finger Lakes. In addition, the silks registration process has been streamlined.

title_en: State Moves to End Hawthorne OTBs and Sports Betting
description: Just hours after denying bankrupt Hawthorne Race Course a racing license or racing dates for 2027, the Illinois Racing Board and Illinois Gaming Board moved to strip the track of its current licenses for racing and sports betting.

title_en: Millionaire Valentine Candy to Stand at Leadem Farm
description: Bob and Tyree Wolesensky have acquired a 45% interest in Valentine Candy, a six-time stakes winner and graded stakes-placed son of 2018 Triple Crown winner Justify. Valentine Candy will stand at their Leadem Farm near Leola, Ark., for $4,000.

title_en: Half to Magnitude Headlines Fedamore's Book 2 Offerings
description: Barry Clohessy has spent more than 25 years immersed in numerous facets of the Thoroughbred business, from exercise riding and caring for lay-ups to breaking yearlings, pinhooking, and sales preparation. Now, he has added consignor to his resume.

title_en: Nyquist Colt Tops Day 3 of Keeneland Sale at $2.25M
description: At the end of the third session, 227 horses had changed hands for gross receipts of $91,997,500, including private sales. That number was up slightly from last year's gross on the corresponding session, when 246 horses brought $89,897,000.

title_en: BH In Session: Strong Sales Continue Into Book 2
description: On BH In Session: Keeneland September: Louie Rabaut recaps the first session of Book 2 and speaks with consignors, buyers, breeders, and more.

title_en: Amo Racing Lands $1.65M Up to the Mark Colt
description: An Up to the Mark colt who is a half brother to 2025 Two Thousand Guineas (G1) winner Ruling Court was on target during the third day of the Keeneland September Yearling Sale Sept. 16, purchased for $1.65 million by Kia Joorabchian's Amo Racing USA.

title_en: Farfellow Farms-Bred Gun Runner Filly Commands $1.5M
description: Farfellow Farms struck a major home run during the Book 2 opening session of the Keeneland September Yearling Sale Sept. 16 when its homebred filly by Gun Runner commanded $1.55 million from Mayberry Farm, bidding on behalf of C R K Stables.

title_en: After the Finish Line Hosts Saddle Towel Fundraiser
description: After the Finish Line is hosting the horse racing industry's largest fundraiser of saddle towels donated by 32 racetracks and trainers across the United States to benefit off-track Thoroughbreds. The fundraiser begins Sept. 18.

title_en: Lieblongs Purchase Nyquist Colt for $2.25M at Keeneland
description: Breeders Fred Hertrich III and John Fielding strike gold Sept. 16 during the third day of the Keeneland September Yearling Sale, selling a Nyquist colt for $2.25 million out of a Bernardini mare Hertrich purchased seven years ago for $40,000.

title_en: Dubb Gives Builder's Thumbs Up to New Belmont Park
description: When Michael Dubb raves about the new half-billion-dollar Belmont Park, his words carry immense weight.

title_en: Congress Advances Horseplayer-Friendly Tax Legislation
description: A bill that includes an industry-backed provision to restore horseplayers' ability to claim 100% of their losses against any winnings in tax filings took a step forward Sept. 16.

description: Searching for his breakthrough moment at the graded level, War Court meets Maycocks Bay and three other foes in the CA$175,000 Durham Cup Stakes (G3), a 1 1/16-mile main-track test Sept. 19 at Woodbine.

title_en: Bright Light Among Latest Wildcards for Arqana Arc Sale

title_en: Racing Board Nixes Hawthorne Bid for '27 Race Dates
description: The Illinois Racing Board has denied applications by bankrupt Hawthorne Race Course for racing licenses and racing dates for 2027, leaving Fairmount Park the only operating track in Illinois.

title_en: LTBA, Louisiana Downs to Award Scholarships Sept. 19
description: The Louisiana Thoroughbred Breeders Association and Louisiana Downs will collectively award four scholarships, each valued at $1,000, on Sept. 19, Louisiana Cup Day.

description: Del Mar reports an overall 3.1% increase in its summer handle. Computer-assisted wagering handle on the Del Mar meet fell 6.7%, while the larger non-CAW portion of the handle rose 6.6%.

title_en: Big Fields, Lucrative Purses Enliven Belmont Undercard
description: As much as the racing end of the Sept. 18 opening day at the new Belmont Park will be focused on Forever Young in the Jockey Club Gold Cup Stakes (G1), the other eight races on the card should provide a welcoming treat for horsemen and fans.

description: The 2026 live racing season at Colonial Downs saw new highs for the number of races and race days, horses in competition, prize money awarded, and wagering handle.

description: On Sept. 16 five major North American professional sports leagues and their players' unions sent a letter to state sports betting regulators asking them to address the "escalating threat" of harassment and violent threats directed at athletes.

description: Reagan's Flame plays to her all-weather-surface racing strength in battling eight other female sprinters in the $300,000 Presque Isle Downs Masters Stakes (G2) the evening of Sept. 18.
